# Load libraries

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(biomaRt)
library(CellChat)
```



# Read in data

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16_tumour_RNAseq <- read_excel("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/rdata/data_tumours/tumours_bulk_RNAseq/GSE294100_B16_counts.xlsx")
```



# Make vector describing the experimental conditions and add to metadata (Sample Table)

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Prepare counts matrix
B16_counts <- B16_tumour_RNAseq[, "B16F10_1", drop = FALSE]

B16_counts <- B16_counts[!duplicated(B16_tumour_RNAseq$refGene), ]

rownames(B16_counts) <- B16_tumour_RNAseq$refGene[!duplicated(B16_tumour_RNAseq$refGene)]


# Convert refGene to ENSEMBL
ensembl_ids <- mapIds(
  org.Mm.eg.db,
  keys = rownames(B16_counts),
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  column = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"  # if multiple ENSEMBL IDs, take the first
)

B16_counts_df <- data.frame(
  ensembl_id = ensembl_ids[rownames(B16_counts)],
  B16_counts,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Make ensemble_id rownames
B16_counts_df <- B16_counts_df[!is.na(B16_counts_df$ensembl_id), ]

B16_counts_df <- B16_counts_df[!duplicated(B16_counts_df$ensembl_id), ]

rownames(B16_counts_df) <- B16_counts_df$ensembl_id

B16_counts_df$ensembl_id <- NULL
```



# Calculate TPM

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Make sure counts are numeric
B16_counts_df <- as.matrix(B16_counts_df)
storage.mode(B16_counts_df) <- "numeric"



# 2. Gene lengths (in base pairs)
# Connect to Ensembl
ensembl <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl")

gene_info <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "start_position", "end_position"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = rownames(B16_counts_df),
  mart = ensembl
)

# Calculate gene lengths in base pairs
gene_info$length <- gene_info$end_position - gene_info$start_position + 1

# Make a vector of lengths in the same order as your counts matrix
lengths_kb <- gene_info$length[match(rownames(B16_counts_df), gene_info$ensembl_gene_id)] / 1000

B16_counts_df <- B16_counts_df[!is.na(lengths_kb), , drop = FALSE]
lengths_kb <- lengths_kb[!is.na(lengths_kb)]



# 3. Compute RPK (Reads Per Kilobase)
B16_rpk <- B16_counts_df / lengths_kb



# 4. Compute TPM
B16_TPM <- apply(B16_rpk, 2, function(x) (x / sum(x)) * 1e6)



# 5. Check results
head(B16_TPM)
colSums(B16_TPM)  # each column should sum to ~1e6
```



# Remove unused objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
rm(B16_counts, gene_info, B16_tumour_RNAseq, B16_rpk, lengths_kb, ensembl)
```



# Get list of genes for "Secreted" proteins from Human Protein Atlas, then map to mouse orthologs

## Filter secreted protein list from HPA
### NOTE - I downloaded a list of HPA.

```{r, include=FALSE}
hpa <- read.delim("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/proteinatlas.tsv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

hpa_secreted <- hpa[grepl("Secreted proteins|Predicted secreted proteins", hpa$Protein.class), ]

# Human secreted gene list
hpa_secreted_genes <- hpa_secreted$Ensembl
```


## Map human genes to mouse orthologs
### NOTE - I downloaded a file from BioMart that converted human genes to mouse orthologs

```{r, include=FALSE}
orthologs <- read.table("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/human_to_mouse_orthologs.txt", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "", fill = TRUE)

# Subset for orthology_confidence = 1 (high confidence of gene mapping)
orthologs <- orthologs[orthologs$orthology_confidence == 1, ]

# Filter orthologs for human secreted proteins
orthologs_secreted <- orthologs[orthologs$human_gene_id %in% hpa_secreted_genes, ]

# Filter orthologs for mouse genes
B16_secreted_ids <- unique(orthologs_secreted$mouse_gene_id)
```


## Filter TPM for secreted genes, then for TPM > 0

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16_TPM_secreted <- B16_TPM[rownames(B16_TPM) %in% B16_secreted_ids, , drop = FALSE]

B16_TPM_secreted <- B16_TPM_secreted[B16_TPM_secreted[,1] > 0, , drop = FALSE]
```


## Add in gene names and make rownames

```{r, include=FALSE}
gene_symbols <- mapIds(
    org.Mm.eg.db,
    keys = rownames(B16_TPM_secreted),
    keytype = "ENSEMBL",
    column = "SYMBOL",
    multiVals = "first"
)

B16_TPM_secreted <- as.data.frame(B16_TPM_secreted)

B16_TPM_secreted$gene_symbol <- gene_symbols[rownames(B16_TPM_secreted)]
```


## Get a list of genes secreted by B16 tumours

```{r, include=FALSE}
B16_secreted_genes <- B16_TPM_secreted$gene_symbol
```

```{r, inlcude=FALSE}
write.table(B16_secreted_genes, 
            file = "B16_secreted_genes.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE) 
```



# Get list of matching receptors for secreted genes

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Load the built-in mouse ligand-receptor database
CellChatDB <- CellChatDB.mouse

# Subset the interactions table for ligands in your secreted gene list
lr_B16 <- subset(CellChatDB$interaction, ligand %in% B16_secreted_genes)

# Extract receptors that line up with secreted genes
B16_receptors <- unique(trimws(unlist(strsplit(lr_B16$receptor.symbol, ","))))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
write.table(B16_receptors, 
            file = "B16_secreted_genes_receptors.csv", 
            row.names = FALSE,
            col.names = FALSE,
            quote = FALSE) 
```
